tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa byin rlabs kyi chu gter bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra ya na yo gā nut+ta ra s+ya margad mū la badz+ra ā tsar+ya gu ro yo gash+tsa sam+bistā ra pū dza s+ya bi dhi a d+dhiṣ+ṭha no da dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje theg pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba rdo rje slon dpon bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa byin rlabs kyi chu gter zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun ngag gi dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan kun tu gzigs pa'i ye shes li khri'i lhun po dbang sngon ral pa'i sprin phreng rnam par g.yo ba can/ /gang gi thugs rje'i zla zer dang 'grogs gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer sa gsum snying gi mun pa sel mdzad cing / /byams dang snying rje'i 'dzum dkar mkhyen pa'i bzhin ras las 'ong kun gsal ye shes snang ba ches cher rgyas mdzad pa/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog rje btsun 'khor lo'i mgon dang gnyis med 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis blo gros pad+ma kha 'byed mdzod/ /'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi bka' mdo rgyud dri ma med pa thams cad kyi don gyi snying po/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gnad/ gegs sel zhing yon tan gyi myu gu thams cad bskyed par byed pa'i sa bon gcig pu/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi nying khu/ gdams pa zab dgu sna tshogs kyi bcud gcig tu bsdus pa/ rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam thun mong ma yin pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab mo nyams su blang ba'i tshul 'di ni/ spyir mdo rgyud sngags thams cad du bla ma la brten nas lam bgrod par gsungs kyang / tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya bar byed pa la/ gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i nang nas rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid dang ldan par rdo rje slob dpon bsnyen bsgrub las su rung zhing cho ga rgyal bas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/

dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur ba'i bla ma kho na las rdo rje 'dzin pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byed par 'gyur bas/ rang gi gnas khang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar/ bla ma'i sku dang / dkon mchog gi rten la sogs pa stegs mtho bar na'u bza' dang bcas pa legs par bzhugs pa'i mdud du/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas sogs 'byor pa'i bye brag dang bstun rgya che bar bshams/ rang nyid rten la kha phyogs pas stan nang tshangs can la rdo rje dkyil krung gi 'dug nas/ 'di ltar bsam ste/ khams gsum rigs drug gang du skyes kyang ngan song gsum du ni/ tsha grang / bkres skom/ glen lkugs sogs sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal bzod par dka' bas gzir zhing nyams thag mtho ris gsum na yang lha la 'chi 'pho/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod/ mi la skye rga na 'chi dang / 'dod pa btsal gyi mi rnyed pa/ mi 'dod pa dang 'phrad pa/ dman pa rnams la lus kyi sdug bsngal/ chen po rnams la sems kyi sdug bsngal sogs bgrang ba las 'das pa'i 'gyur ba dang / 'du byed gyi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab/ sdug bsngal de las thar bar byed pa la dam pa'i chos ma gtogs thabs gzhan med cing / de sgrub pa la lus rten dal 'byor mi lus thob par bya dgos na/ de yang rgyu tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrung dgos shing / dpe rus sbal gyi mgrin pa gnya' shing gi bu gar tshud pa ltar rnyed par dka'/ mi lus thob na'ang skyes pa'i tha mar 'chi ba las ma 'das/ 'chi rkyen mang / 'tsho rkyen nyung / 'dzam bu gling pa'i tshe la nges pa med pas/ nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi ba rang thog tu bab pa'i tshe/ rdzas dang sngags dang rten 'brel gang gis kyang mi zlog pas/ de ltar ma byung gong du chos bya zhing / de yang dang po mi dge ba spong zhing / dge ba ci nus bsgrub pa dang / lung ma bstan dge bar bsgyur ba nyid lag len gyi gtso bor bya dgos/ dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can 'di rnams kyang /

rang dang 'brel med ma yin/ skye ba snga mar phan btags shing gnod pa las skyabs pa'i drin can pha ma sha stag yin pas/ 'di thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba la spyod cing / sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba dang bral bar bya/ de ltar byed nus pa sangs rgyas kho na yin pas de bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir/ lam 'di lta bu nyams su blang bar bya/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las skyob par byed pa'i skyabs bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la/ bdag dang pha ma rigs drug thams cad skyabs su 'gro snyam du bsam la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes las/ dang po ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa shūd+dhā sar+b+ba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ tha mal gyi snang ba ming dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i lcags ri khor yug gi bskor ba'i nang du rgya mtsho chen po dwangs shing rnyog pa med pa ma rgad bzhu ba lta bu'i steng phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa'i dbus su rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i ri rab lhun po mdzes shing brjid chags pa'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs pa las byas pa'i gzhal med khang chen po gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa'i steng dang / khor yug kun tu rin po che dang / me tog dang lha'i gos bzang sna tshogs pa las byas pa'i bla bre dang / 'phan gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pa dang / gzhal med khang gi dbus su seng ge chen po brgyad gyi bteg pa'i gser gyi khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan bshams pa/ phyi nang mtha' skor kun du paṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i shel gyi snod dang / a las byung ba'i thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po skyed par byed pa'i lha rdzas kyi mchod yon/

me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa/ gzhan yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos po bzang zhing yid du 'ong ba dngos su 'byor ba dang yid gyi sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ yul nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pa dus 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du bla ma rdo rje slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig/ ༈ /oṃ sar+b+ba oṃ rigs pa thams cad/ bit+pū ra pū ra/ gang ba gang ba/ su ra su ra/ rgyas pa rgyas pa/ ā war+t+ta ya/ kun tu zhugs/ ā warta ya ho/ kun tu zhugs/ oṃ na mo bha ga te badz+ra sā ra pra marti ne/ ta thā ga tā ya ar+ha te/ samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje snying po rab tu 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo// tad+ya thā 'di lta ste oṃ badz+re badz+re oṃ rdo rje ma rdo rje/ ma hā badz+re/ rdo rje chen mo ma/ ma hā te dza badz+re rdo rje gzi brjid chen mo la/ ma hā bi d+yā badz+re rdo rje rig pa chen mo/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re byang chub sems kyi rdo rje chen mo/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍo pa sang kra ma ṇa byang chub chen po yang dag par rig pa bzhin brgyan pa/ sarba kar+m+ma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+re swā hā las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong bar byed pa'i rdo rje ma/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta rdo rje'i chos sgrogs pa/ pra ra ṇi ta rab tu sgrogs/ sam+p+ra ra ṇi ta kun nas rab tu sgrogs/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad/ pra tsa li ni rab tu g.yo bar byed pa/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ nā da swa bhā be na badz+ra dharma hṛ da sgra'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje chos kyi thugs ya ni san+to ṣa ṇi yang dag par mnyes par byed pa/

hūm̐&hoḥ& ā khaṃ swā hā/ ces brjod/ skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa ni/ gong du smos pa'i bsam pa de lta bus/ ngag tu/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma mkha' mnyam chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la༞ bla ma sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku la༞ bla ma kun khyab ngo bo nyid kyi sku la༞ sku bzhi dbyer med bla ma rin po che la༞ ye shes lnga ldan bla ma rin po che la༞ bde stong zung 'jug bla ma rin po che la༞ dam chos kun 'byung bla ma rin po che la༞ dge 'dun mnga' bdag bla ma rin po che la༞ bstan srung kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la༞ nor lha'i gtso bo bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan bdun bya'o/ /bla ma rin po che dang dkon mchog rnam pa gsum pa bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ chos lam du longs par byin gyis brlab gsol/ lam 'khrul pa sel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'khrul snang ye shes su 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi blo la chos ma yin pa'i rnam par rtog pa skad cig kyang mi skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshar gsum/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab pa'i lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ mdun du rten bsam pa/ de la mchod pa 'bul ba/ dbang dang dngos grub blang ba/ de kho na nyid kyi don bsgom pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sngar gyi gzhal med khang chen po'i dbus kyi gdan steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mnyam pa med pa'i bka' drin can/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rigs drug pa rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang /

chos kyi dbyings de bzhin nyid las mi 'gyur bas/ sku mdog sngon po/ de kho na nyid ro gcig par rtogs pas zhal gcig pa/ bden pa gnyis zung du 'jug pas phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ g.yon pas stong pa nyid kyi sgra sgrog pa'i dngul dkar gyi dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas bzung ba/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' mnan pas zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gi bzhugs shing / sku mdzes pa'i dpal dang gzi brjid 'bar ba/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pas zab mo rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi sgra sgrog pa/ thugs bde stong dbyer med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la snyoms par 'jug bzhin pa/ bdag la dges pa'i 'dzum mdangs can/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' sna tshogs dang / rin po che'i rgyan 'od zer kun tu 'phro bas rnam par brgyan pa/ mthong thos dran reg tsam gyi bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi mchog stsol bar mdzad pa/ de'i dpral bar zla ba'i steng du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin āḥdamar po/ /thugs khar nyi ma'i steng du sangs rgyas thams cad gyi thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin hūm̐ sngon po/ gzhan yang sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin/ phung po lnga chos nyid dang bcas pa rgyal ba rigs drug 'byung ba lnga yum lnga/ tshigs dang rtsa rgyud dbang po drug rnams byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ tshigs chen bcu khro bo dang khro mo/ yul 'dod yon lnga mchod pa'i lha mo'i ngo bo/ /de'i mtha' skor du/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa dang / rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la sogs pa brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang /

yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems/ 'phags pa rang sangs rgyas/ nyan thos/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis yongs su bskor zhing dges par bzhugs pa/ gnyis pa mchod pa dbul ba la/ thog mar gsol ba btab pa/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod pa 'bul ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mdun gyi rten de rnams thams cad dang / khyad par rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs snyam pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ ngag tu/ 'dren mchog bla ma kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /grub stsol yi dam thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bka' srungs rnams kyi mnga' bdag bla ma la/ /sgo gsum dang bas kun nas mgos phyag 'tshal/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /dngos grub kun stsol yi dam lha yi tshogs/ /nus pa phul byung chos skyong bsrung ma la/ /rnam dag blo yi kun nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul bdag pos ma bzung dang / /bdag lus dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs dang bcas/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba de kho na'i/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho kun du bzang po yid/ /rnam 'phrul ji bzhin kun nas legs bkod de/ /rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing rnams ma lus pa/ /legs par bkang ste sgo gsum dngas bas 'bul/ /bgyis dang bgyid bstsal bgyi la yid rang ba'i/ /thog med 'khor bar bsags pa'i sdig pa kun/ /'gro ba kun gyis bsags pa'i sdig pa dang / /lhan cig rab mnong sdom pa'i sems kyi bshags/ /kun gyi dge la rjes su yid rang zhing / /rtag par chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /dge rnams bla med byang chub chen por bsngo/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /srid dang zhi ba'i rgyud pa thams cad la/ /nye bar skyob pa'i skyabs gnas mchog nyid du/ /dpal ldan bla ma khyed la gsol 'debs kyis/

/srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun las bskyab tu gsol/ /myang 'das skal pa'i gnas las drang du gsol/ /'dod rgu rin chen ma lus bstsal du gsol/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnyis pa phyi'i mchod pa la gsum/ bdag pos ma bzung ba'i mchod pa/ mchod yon me tog sogs thun mong gi mchod pa/ gzugs sogs 'dod yon gyi mchod pa 'bul ba'o/ /dang po bdag pos ma bzung ba'i mchod pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bdag pos ma bzung ba'i rtsi shing nags tshal chu bo sogs 'bul bar bsam la/ ngag tu/ phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'jig rten na/ /bdag pos ma bzung sman ljongs nyams dga' bar/ /me tog 'bras bu dud pa'i dpag bsam shing / /dri bzang lo 'dab rgyas pa'i sman rnams dang / /gtsang zhing yid 'ong 'bab chu lhung lhung sgrog /dbang sngon margad pad+ma rā ga dang / /ga purma ṇi la sogs rin chen mchog /rab tu spungs pa'i rin chen ri rab dang / /bsil ba'i ngad ldan kha ba'i lhun po mchog /mtho zhing lhun sdug brag ri'i ngos yangs dang / /rtsa sngon ljon shing bkram pa'i nags tshal dang / /pad+ma'i mtsho la chu bya sna tshogs pa/ /mdog legs spu sdug shin tu skad snyan cing / /bung ba gzhon nus gar bsgyur glu dbyangs len/ /ri dwags du ma dal zhing rtse gar byed/ /ma rmos ma btab 'bru sna ci yang skye/ /gzhan yang mdzes shing yid chags dngos po'i tshogs/ /mkho zhing longs spyod 'os pa ji snyed kyang / /'dzin med blo yi rab tu 'bul lags na/ /dges pas bzhes nas gnas lugs rtogs par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje'i slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba ni mchod pa bzhes shig wān+sargu ru badz+ra ā tsār+ya sa pa ri wā ra/ pa ti na a pa ri gṛ ha pū dza pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gnyis pa mchod yon me tog sogs thun mong gi mchod pa ni/ lha dang mi yi btung ba'i mchog gyur gang /

/mdog legs dri zhim ro bcud brgya ldan pa/ lus sems tshim zhing zag med bde ba bskyed/ /gtsang zhing yid 'phrog mchod yon dam pa dang / kha dog rab bkra dbyibs mdzes dri bsung can/ /chu dang thang las skyes pa'i pad+ma dang / /ut+pal la sogs me tog gdugs dang 'phan/ /rgyal mtshan do shal phreng ba'i khyad par dang / /a ka ru dang tsan dan si h+la/ /rgya spos la sogs bdug spos ji snyed dang / /nyi zla yid bzhin nor bu'i snang gsal dang / /mar me'i phreng ba mtshar du bsgrigs pa dang / /ga pur gur gum ri shi la sogs pa/ /bsil ba'i ngad ldan byug pa'i dri chab mchog /lus srog 'tsho ba'i dpal dang bde chen gyi/ /ye shes bskyed byed lha mi'i zhal zas gang / /pi wang gling bu paṭ+ṭa ha la sogs/ /snyan brjid yid 'khul rol mo'i bye brag tshogs/ /gzhan yang lha mi'i mchod rdzas seng ge'i khri/ bla bre gdan dang rnga yab ba dan dang / /rin chen rgyan phreng khang bzang dam pa sogs/ /yid 'phrog mchod pa'i tshogs 'di dbul bar bgyi/ /brtse ba chen pos nye bar bzhes nas kyang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /oṃ shrī dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje'i slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa mchod yon la sogs pa thun mong gi mchod pa bzhes shig wān+saṅgu ru badz+ra ā tsār+ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+gha mā di sā dha ra ṇa pu dza pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gsum pa 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ kha dog mdzes shing dbyibs legs lta na sdug /legs byas dpal las grub pa'i gzugs mchog dang / /glu dbyangs rnga bo che dang bsil snyan tshogs/ /zin dang ma zin sgra snyan ji snyed dang / /dri 'dzin tshim byed mnyam dang mi mnyam pa'i/ /dri gsung mchod pa'i khyad par gang dag dang / /ro brgya'i bcud ldan lha rdzas zhal zas sogs/ /yid 'phrog bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs rnams dang / /dro 'jam yang mdzes kha dog rnam par bkra/ /bde ba'i mchog bskyed reg bya'i mchod pa dang /

/gzhan yang 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i long spyod mchog /ri rab gling bzhi sum cu rtsa gsum bcas/ /nyi zla rin chen bdun dang btsun mo'i 'khor/ /dpa' zhing brtul phod sras dang blon po stong / /nye ba'i rin chen bdun sogs 'jig rten nas/ /ches dkon yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing / /'dod dgu kun 'byung mchog bum bzang ba dang / /ma btab lo tog bkra shis dpal be'u sogs/ /ngo mtshar rtags dang rdzas kyi cha byad dang / /gzhan yang nor 'bru gos dang sman la sogs/ /bdag gir bzung ba'i long spyod thams cad dang / /dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /dpal ldan bla ma khyed la dbul bar bgyid/ /sdang zhen rmongs pa'i 'dzin pa sbyang du gsol/ /oṃ shrī wān+saṅgu ru badz+ra ā tsār+ya sa pa ri wā dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje'i slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa bzhes shig ra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇā de bā h+ya pū dza pra tits+tsha swā hā/ gnyis pa nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ rang lus thal mal phung po nyes kun gzhi/ /ye shes ral gri rno ngar ldan pa yis/ /thod pa bcad nas snod du byas pa'i nang / /rkang pa nas brtsams yan lag lhu bral te/ /dum bur btub shing thod pa'i nang bcug la/ /rang sems rlung dang dbyer med yi dam lha/ /dran nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥbadud rtsi yid/ /rgya mtsho zad mi shes shing kha dog dang / /dri ro bcud ldan bde chen bskyed byed 'di/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du 'bul/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du 'bul/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du 'bul/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhal du 'bul/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i zhal du 'bul/ /'phags pa rang rgyal rnams kyi zhal du 'bul/ /dgra bcom nyan thos rnams kyi zhal du 'bul/ /dpal mgon chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ gnod sbyin nor lha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

/dges shing tshims nas dngos grub stsol gyur cig /pha ma la sogs 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /yi dam lhar gsal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rigs drug sdug bsngal kun dang bral gyur cig /lan chags bu lon sha 'khon gnyer ba yi/ /mi dang mi min gnod byed tshogs la 'bul/ /lan chags khyer nas gnod sems zhi gyur cig /bdud rtsi'i lhag ma snod dang bcas pa dang / /gzhan yang 'jig rten khams kyi bcud len rdzas/ /lcags kyu sgron ma ye shes lnga sbyar ba'i/ /zag med bde ba skyed byed bdud rtsi'i tshogs/ /ma lus rtsa ba'i bla ma khyed la 'bul/ /bdag la dges pas myur du bzhes su gsol/ /bde chen ye shes da lta nyid du stsol/ /oṃ shrī wān+saṅgu ru dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje'i slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa nang gi bdag nyid bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bzhes shig badz+ra ā tsār+ya sa pa ri wā ra a dh+yat+ma a mṛ ta pū dza pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim bde ba'i ro/ /'dod dgu'i reg bya tshad med bde ba bskyed/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma yi dngos/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid phyag rgyar 'bul/ /'dzag med dga' bzhi'i ye shes lhan cig skyes/ /rnam par rtog bral rang rig 'od gsal mchog /'gyur med bde chen yang dag don gzigs pa'i/ /spros bral ye shes lhag par mngon mdzad nas/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi/ /srid pa'i rtsa ba 'pho chags phra mo 'di/ /zung 'jug ye shes nyid du byin rlabs nas/ /zag med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog /oṃ shrī wān+saṅgu ru dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa shes rab phyag rgya gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhes shig badz+ra ā tsār+ya sa pa ri wā ra pra dz+nyā mu tra ra h+ya sa pū dza pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ mchod pa'i yul gyur bla ma dam pa dang /

/mchod pa'i dngos po phyi nang gsang ba'i rdzas/ /mchod par byed mkhan sgrub po bdag nyid rnams/ /logs na med kyang rang sems me long dngos/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i snang brnyan sna tshogs shar/ /snang ba de nyid stong pa'i rang gzugs la/ /stong pa'ang snang ba btsal las ma rnyed pa/ /snang stong gnyis kyi ngo bo dbyer med kyang / /kun rtog blo yis ldog pa so sor phye/ /snang stong rang bzhin gcig min tha dad min/ /tha dad med bzhin 'gal ba ltar snang ba'i/ /brjod med snang srid phyag rgya chen mo ni/ /'dzin med bla mar 'bul gyi don rtogs mdzod/ /oṃ shrī wān+saṅgu ru badz+ra ā tsār+ya sa pa ri wā ra ma hā mu trā ta twam+pu dza pra trits+tsha swā hā/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa phyag rgya chen mo de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa bzhes shig gsum pa dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni/ thog mar gsol ba 'di ltar btab ste/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bla ma sangs rgyas kyis/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las rnams/ /gcig tu bsdus pa sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dngos/ /ye shes lnga dang yan lag bdun ldan zhing / /'khor 'das kun khyab brtan g.yo'i dpal gcig bu/ /dam chos kun gyi 'byung gnas dge 'dun che/ /chos skyong nor lha'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje/ /thugs rje chen po byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /lus la bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol/ /rtsa yi dri ma mtha' dag sbyang du gsol/ /snang ba lha ru 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor 'das dbyer med mngon du 'gyur bar mdzod/ /ngag la gsang ba'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol/ /yi ge'i dri ma mtha' dag sbyang du gsol/ /gsal stong zung 'jug rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs mngon du byin gyis rlobs/ /yid la shes rab ye shes dbang mchog stsol/ /bdud rtsi'i dri ma༞ /bde stong zung 'jug rtogs par༞

/ye shes chen po༞ /mchog dbang rin chen bzhi pa bstsal du gsol/ /rlung gi dri ma mtha' dag sbyang du gsol/ /chos kun bde stong chen po rtogs par mdzod/ /shin tu rnam dag mngon du 'gyur bar mdzod/ /ces gsol ba drag tu btab pas nor lha rnams 'od du zhu chos skyong la thims/ de nyan thos la/ de rang rgyal la/ de byang sems la/ de sangs rgyas la/ de yi dam la/ de brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ de rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ de la gus 'dud dung dung pa byas la/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar byung / oṃ yig phreng ba byung nas dpral bar zhugs/ lus dang rtsa yi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs/ bum pa'i dbang thob sku yi byin rlabs zhugs/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i ā las 'od dmar dang / a yig phreng ba byung nas mgrin par zhugs/ ngag dang yi ge'i dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ bla ma'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon dang / hūm̐ yig phreng ba byung nas snying khar zhugs/ yid dang bdud rtsi'i dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs/ gsum pa'i dbang thob thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sku gsung thugs las 'od zer sna tshogs dang 'bru gsum phreng ba byung nas sgo gsum zhugs/ ye shes rlung gis dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs/ bzhi pa'i dbang thob sku bzhi'i ngo bor gyur/ snyam du mos nas cung zad mnyam par bzhag /bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi don bsgom pa ni/ yang gsol ba 'di ltar btab ste/ dpag yas byin rlabs dngos grub kun gyi bzhi/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter chen chos kyi rje/ /bdag la myur du thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /yul snang sems su rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems nyid sgyu mar༞ /rten 'brel brjod bral༞ /zung 'jug lhan skyes rtogs༞ /bde chen spros med༞ /'od gsal mtshan med༞

/rang rig 'gyur med rtogs par༞ /rnam kun mchog ldan༞ /gnyis med phyag chen༞ /zab gsal stong nyid rtogs༞ /kun khyab ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag gi dka' spyad 'bad pa cher byas kyang / /snying po'i don mchog rtogs par mi 'gyur bas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rje byin brlab kyis/ /ye shes gzigs pa mngon sum 'jug gyur cig /ces gsol ba btab pas bla ma de rang gi spyi gtsug tu byon zhing / bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas rang la gnyis su med par thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur te/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa yin no snyam du sems ma yengs par mnyam par gzhag go /bsgom gyi nyams myong cung zad yod na de dang bsres nas bsgom pas zhi lhag zung 'brel rnam par mi rtog par lhan gyi 'gro yang / nyams myong med pa'i las dang po la de'i rjes su gzhigs te stong nyid bsgom dgos pas/ de yang lung rigs kyis sgrubs na skye dka' bas man ngag gi sgom tshul ni 'di ltar bsam ste/ e ma ho/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ni rang gi sems las logs su gyur pa med pas thams cad rang gi sems yin snyam du blo thag bcad/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / 'khor ba thams cad rigs drug dang / khams gsum du ma 'dus pa med/ rigs drug gis bag chags sems la zhen pas lus grub pa'i tshe rigs drug gi rtsa yi ge'i rnam par chags/ der thog mar rlung rgyus pas/ mi la sogs pa'i 'dod khams rigs drug so so'i snang ba bden bden po 'di 'char/ bsam gtan gyi oṃ dang / snying po'i ar rlung sems 'dus pas gzugs/ gzugs med kyi snang ba 'byung la/ de yang snang mkhan so so'i ngo bor chu phor pa gang lta bu la snag khrag dang bdud rtsi sogs su snang yang / don la chu de snag khrag dang bdud rtsi chu sogs gang yang ma yin kyang /

lus rten so sor skyes pa'i tshe snang ba de dag dgag mi thub par so sor snang zhing snang ba'i cha de la legs par brtags shing dpyad na chu dang bdud rtsi sogs gang du yang ma grub ste/ grub na chur grub bam/ bdud rtsir grub/ gang yang ma yin bzhin snang mkhan gyi shes pa nyid/ de dang de'i rnam par shar ba la rigs drug so so'i snang bar ming btags/ des na snang ba de snang mkhan gyi blo las logs su med snang ba de sems yin/ de bzhin du myang 'das kyi phyogs rnams kyang des mtshon nas shes par bya ste/ mdor na ma dag pa'i snang ba/ nyams gyi snang ba/ dag pa'i snang ba ci shar rung rmi lam gyi snang ba ltar sems nyid yin/ 'o na rmi lam gyi snang ba yun thung la/ gzhan snang ba rnams yun ring bar 'char ba ji ltar yin snyam na/ de ni bag chags 'thas ma 'thas kyi khyad par las snang yun ring thung byung ba ma gtogs snang ba rang gi ngo bo sems yin thag chod do/ /de ltar chos thams cad sems kyi byas shing byung ba kho na yin no snyam du 'dzin na/ mu stegs byed kyi bdag rtag pa gcig bu thams cad kyi byed pa por 'dod pa dang mtshungs pas/ yang 'di ltar bsam ste/ rang gi sems nyid kho nas 'khor 'das thams cad byed nus pa yang ma yin/ sems kyi rgyu'i gtso bo byas/ rkyen gzhan gang yang rung ba rnams la brten nas snang ba sna tshogs shar ba yin/ sems kho nas 'byung ba yin na/ gang bsam pa'i dngos po de de ma thag 'byung dgos pa la/ de mi 'byung bar rgyu rkyen gzhan las rag las pa mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir/ dper na nam mkha' dwangs pa la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shar ba'i tshe/ snod tha dad pa du mar chu la zla ba'i gzugs brnyan 'char gyi sems kho nas zla ba'i gzugs brnyan gnang mi nus des na snang ba sna tshogs thams cad rgyu rkyen du 'tshogs na snang la ma 'tshogs na mi snang bas sgyu ma nyid do/ yang 'di ltar bsam ste/

sems rang gi ngo bo la brtag pa'i tshe yang / thog ma 'di tsam nas byung / da lta 'di na gnas/ mthar 'di bzhin 'gag skad cig gi cha shas phye ba'i tshe/ sems skad cig ma dang po dang / gnyis pa gang las snang ba byung / rgyu rkyen gzhan las ma byung na/ rgyu 'bras dus mnyam mam/ rgyu'i dus na 'bras bu med/ 'bras bu'i dus na rgyu med pa sogs legs par bsam na/ rang bzhin nam/ ngo bo ma rnyed/ ma rnyed bzhin du snang ba mi 'gag pas 'di ka rgod bro/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang / pra ti t+ya sa mut+pā da/ ces bya ba las gsung rgyu med do/ /de'i sgra bshad na/ so so brten zhing skye ba/ zhes sgra ji bzhin pa las 'byung yang / sngon gyi lo tsā ba chos kyi de nyid gzigs pa rnams kyi rten cing 'brel par 'byung bar bsgyur/ dang po ni/ dper na rgyu sa bon kho na las 'bras bu mi 'byung / rkyen drod chu lud/ skyes bu'i brtsol ba rnams re re las kyang mi 'byung na yang / blo rags pa'i ngo bor/ sa bon las myu gu sdong bu lo ma me tog 'bras bu sogs rim par 'byung ngo snyam du zhen cing 'dzin/ de bzhin du chos thams cad kyang snga ma snga ma la brten nas phyi ma phyi ma 'brel zhing 'byung ba ltar snang ba tsam la rten 'brel zer te/ skad cig snga ma la ma brten par phyi ma mi 'byung / snga ma phyi mar 'phos pa yang ma yin te/ des mtshon nas bskal pa snga phyi/ skye ba snga phyi/ lo snga phyi/ dbyar dgun/ zla ba snga phyi/ zhag snga phyi/ snga dro dang dgong mo/ /'khor ba dang myang 'das/ sems can dang sangs rgyas/ rdul phran snga phyi/ shes pa'i skad cig snga phyi sogs shes bya thams cad la brtag na de kho na ltar gnas pas rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'o/ /kun rdzob tu de ltar yin kyang / don legs par bsam na chos thams cad brjod pa dang bral ba yin te/ dpes mtshon na dbang po'i bde ba'am/ longs spyod kyi rlabs lta bu'i dus rang gi sems la sems su myong rgyu cig byung kyang /

rjes la 'di ltar byung zhes smra mi shes pa/ de bzhin du chos kyi rang bzhin 'di ltar ro/ /zhes sangs rgyas kyi brjod par ma nus na/ gzhan so so skye bos brjod ga la shes/ 'di ka chos thams cad kyi ngo bo yin pas gnas lugs yin zhes bya/ kun rdzob snang ba'i cha la brtag shing dpyad pas ma snyed pa de ka don dam/ don dam stong bzhin du kun rdzob kyi snang ba mi 'gags pas bden pa gnyis zung 'jug gsal ba dang stong pa lhan cig tu 'byung bas lhan skyes/ 'khor 'das thams cad zhu bde lhan skyes skad cig ma cig gi ngo bor snang bas bde chen/ yod med gnyis ka dang / gnyis ka ma yin pa'i spros pas dben pas spros med/ shes bya thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang bas 'od gsal lo/ /gzung 'dzin gyi mtshan ma dang bral bas mtshan med/ rang gi ngo bo nyams su myong bas na rang rig dmyal ba nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar gang du song yang rang bzhin mi 'gyur bas 'gyur med/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos kun gyi rnam pa ma 'dres shing mchog tu gsal bar gzigs pas rnam kun mchog ldan/ shes rab kyis ro gcig par rtogs pas gnyis med/ shes bya thams cad bde stong gi ye shes kyis rgyas 'debs pas phyag rgya chen po/ phra zhing rtogs par dka' la rnyog pa med pas rab gsal/ gshis cir yang ngos bzung ma rnyed pas stong nyid/ 'khor 'das thams cad ngo bo de kho na las ma 'das pas kun khyab/ yin lugs khong du chud pas ye shes so/ /yang 'di ltar bsam ste/ mdor na chos thams cad rang bzhin stong pa/ mtshan nyid gsal ba/ ngo bo zung 'jug yin thag chod do snyam pa'i ngang la rnam rtog ma skyes bar du rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag 'og 'gyur mi 'chor ba'i dran pa bsten/ gsal le/ sing nge / yer re/ hrig ge 'bol le/ lhod de/ sbring nge / sems la sems kyi lta zhing bzhag go /de ltar rnam rtog gi 'jug pa zhi nas/

rtse gcig tu mer mer gnas kyang rig pa'i rang mdangs ma shar ba dang / shes pa'i dngas cha ma rnyed na zhi gnas ltengs po zhes pa rnam rtog kha 'khyims pa'i zhi gnas yin gyi mi rtog par lhag gi ma song ba yin no/ /mi rtog pa la rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i ngang la mar me rlung gi bskyod pa ltar shes pa'i rang gdangs thon te/ gsal le sing nge gnas na nyams sna tshogs skye ba'i zhi gnas zhes bya ste thun gcig la sogs pa'i bar du byung na'ang 'od gsal gyi snang ba mi skye mi srid do/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mnyam gzhag de las langs te/ spyod lam la 'jug pa 'dod na/ 'o chos rnams kyi rang bzhin zab mo ma rtogs par/ rang gi rang sdug tu 'jug pa'i sems can 'di rnams zhe thag pa nas snying rje/ 'di thams cad kyi rnal 'byor zab mo 'di lta bu bsgom zhing myur du sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir bsngo ba dang smon lam 'debs snyam/ ngag tu/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du bsgrubs nas tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'khod par shog /de lta'i go 'phang dam pa ma thob bar/ /skye ba kun tu dal 'byor lus bzang ldan/ /tshul khrims ngur smrig gos mchog gtsang ma dang / /bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes par shog /rgyal ba'i chos tshul chu gter cher zhugs nas/ /mang du thos shing bsam dang bsgom pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor bu brtson pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /rtag tu nyer bkod skye dgu'i phan bde shog /mi rtag 'khor ba'i chu srin gyis skrag cing / /long med 'chi bdag mun pa'i dmag mthong nas/ /rnyed dka' 'jig par sla ba'i dal 'byor rten/ /mi dge spong zhing dge la brtson par shog /rigs drug sems can 'di dag thams cad kyang / /skye ba snga mar yang yang phan btags pa'i/ /drin can pha mar shes nas byams pa dang / /snying nas brtse ba'i bsam pa 'byongs par shog

/pha rol phyin pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba mchog /byang chub sems gnyis nan tan bsgom pa dang / /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal ma lus bdag smin nas/ /rang gi bde dge gzhan la gtong bar shog /khyad par dus gsum rgyal ba'i bgrod gcig lam/ /rmad byung rdo rje theg la rab dad pas/ /rdo rje 'chang chen dpal ldan bla ma la/ /dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhis smin par shog /dbang gi smin nas grol bar byed pa'i lam/ /snang ba lha bsgom drag pa sngags su 'char/ /sems kyi nyams snang 'char sgo ci shar kyang / /zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po rtogs par shog /bar chad sel zhing dngos grub kun gyi gzhi/ /zab mo lam mchog bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di/ /the tshom yid gnyis spangs te rtse gcig bsgom/ /byin rlabs rtags mtshan 'phral du 'byung bar shog /mnyam par gzhag tshe 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /rang rig 'od gsal rig pa skad cig ma/ /nyams su myong zhing ngo bo brjod dang bral/ /bde stong dbyer med mngon sum rtogs par shog /rjes thob kun du lus kyi mi dge ba/ /srog gcod rku dang 'khrig pa'i las spong zhing / /bla ma'i ched du lus srog gtong phod pas/ /sku yi dam tshig mi nyams bsrung bar shog /ngag gi brdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub dang / /ngag 'khyal spong zhing bla ma'i yon tan dang / /bstod pa snyan grags brjod cing sngags bzlas pas/ /gsung gi dam tshig mi nyams༞ /brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba sogs/ /yid kyi mi dge spong zhing bla ma 'di/ /snying nas sangs rgyas dngos yin bsam pa yis/ /thugs kyi dam tshig mi nyams bsrung bar shog /bdag gi lus srog longs spyod dus gsum gyi/ /dge tshogs ji snyed bla ma'i phyogs su gtong / /khong yus nga rgyal khyad gsod mi bsgom par/ /bla ma'i thugs dgos ma lus sgrub par shog /sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad spyod rnam thar la/ /skyon gyi rnam pa 'ga' yang mi rtog cing / /rmad byung rgyal ba'i mdzad pa sha stag tu/

/legs par shes shing yid ches skye bar shog /mdor na bla ma mnyes pa'i thabs 'tshol zhing / /mi mnyes 'gyur ba'i las sgrib kun spangs te/ /'bral med snying gi dkyil du rtag brten nas/ rnam pa kun du mi g.yel rjes 'dzin shog /kun rdzob bla ma sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /don dam bla ma 'khor 'das kun la khyab/ /rang rig bla ma rang sems gdod ma'i mgon/ /snang srid bla ma'i ngo bor rtogs par shog /skye ba 'di dang ji srid sangs rgyas bar/ /rdo rje 'chang chen dpal ldan bla ma mchog /nam yang 'bral med dad pas rab brten cing / /zhal gyi bdud rtsis rtag tu 'tsho bar shog /chos mthun 'byor pas tshe ring gnas pa dang / /byang chub sems mchog rim gnyis rnal 'byor sogs/ /rtse gcig zab mo'i ting 'dzin bsgom pa la/ /bar chad med cing mthun rkyen rgyas par shog /gnas skabs kun du dam pa'i chos spyod cing / /rang rgyud grol nas mar gyur skye dgu rnams/ /skal ba ji bzhin rnam grol lam bstan nas/ /yongs su smin cing grol bar byed gyur cig /gtsug gi nor bu bla ma'i thugs rje dang / skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / /rdo rjes chos skyong nus mthu dpag yas pas/ /bsam pa ji bzhin rtag tu 'grub gyur cig /ces bsngo ba dang smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas btab ste/ spyod lam thams cad du bla ma'i zhabs tog dang phrin las ci 'grub kyi dge ba'i bya ba la 'bad cing sgyu ma lta bur rang gzhan gyi don bya ba dang / mchod rdzas dman pa rnams bsdus te chos mthun gyi spyod pas ci bder rgyu'o/ /dus gsum rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos tshul dpag yas las/ /rab zab rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam kun gyi gtso/ /rmad byung rdo rje slob dpon la brten bla ma yi/ /rnal 'byor mchog 'di thos shing rtag tu 'bad par rigs/ /gsang chen rgyud sde'i chu gter chen po las/ /bslu med rje btsun mchog gi ded dpon gyis/

/man ngag nor bu'i phreng ba rab blangs pa/ /kun gyi gtsug tor rnal 'byor 'di yin no/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen rnyed dka' zhing / /mi lus thob kyang chos dang mjal ba dka'/ /chos kyi nang nas gsang chen rgya mtsho'i bcud/ /rnal 'byor mchog 'di thos pa shin tu dka'/ /thos kyang yid ches nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ /yid ches na yang mang po'i tshul gyis khengs/ /thos pa'i chang gi myos shing rigs pa yi/ /kun tu dregs shing rnam par sgyings pas na/ /yid bzhin nor bu mchog 'di spangs su dogs/ /ma spangs na yang snyoms las le lo'i bdud/ /chen cher 'phel bas btang snyoms bzhugs pa las/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa ches rab dkon/ /'ga' zhig gzhan don ltar snang bdud kyis 'khyer/ /la la bcol chung man ngag mig dang bral/ /kha cig snying po'i don gyi brda mi go /gzhan dag chags sdang 'khrul pas dri mas gos/ /kye ma dang ni snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus/ /dal 'byor chud zos stong log ma byed par/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi rtag dran byos la/ /snyoms las phyi shol bdud kyi ma 'khyer bar/ /mi tshe thos par bskyal kyang go don chung / /de bas snying po'i don mchog bla ma bsten/ /zab dgu nyon la nyams len gcig la dril/ /rnam grangs mang kyang dgos dus phan mi thogs/ /kha bshad chos kyis bar do'i 'phrang mi khegs/ /nyams myong med na 'chi khar tsab tsob ldang / /gnad gcig ma zin cal col mang pos bsdu/ /des na tshe 'di'i 'dun ma blos btang nas/ /rnal 'byor zab mo 'di la nan tan gyis/ /yengs med brjod med bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ /kha tsam min par snying nas yang yang soms/ /dmyal bar song yang re sa gzhan med snyam/ /snying nas dad gus kha zhe mthun byas na/ /nam yang mi bslu thugs rjes myur bzung nas/ /bde chen mchog gi gnas su 'dren par nges/ /'di brtsams dge ba kun+da'i phung po ltar dkar gang thob des/

/skye dgu mtha' dag sdug bsngal rgya mtsho che las rab bsgral te/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i sa dang lam rnams rim gyis myur bgrod nas/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam grol ye shes bde ba che la 'god gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni la stod lho'i sa skyong nus ldan mi'i dbang po shrī gu ru rat+na bha tra'i gsung gi bskul bas rgyan byas shing gzhan yang don gnyer 'ga' yis bskul nas/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sa glang gi lo chu stod zla ba'i nyer lnga la dpal byas 'gyur rdo rje'i ri khrod du brtsams pa'i yi ge pa ni tsan+t+ra kīrti'o/ /nyams len bsdus pa kho bos logs na bris yod// //e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
